# Year 13 Graduation Ceremony
39 university offers from 26 universities across 6 countries, that’s the proud achievement of ISPH’s Year 13 students this academic year.
From the UK, Australia, Canada, Ireland, Hong Kong to Vietnam, our students have proven their ability, resilience, and readiness to take on new challenges in diverse international learning environments.
On 25 June, ISPH hosted the very first Year 13 Graduation Ceremony, a historic milestone not only for the students but also for their teachers, parents, and the entire ISPH community.
This first graduating cohort, the students who have journeyed with ISPH since the very beginning, have together created some of the school’s most memorable milestones.

content.text:
ISPH graduates have gone on to universities in several countries. The school’s alumni page lists examples including:

- **United States:** New York University, Drew University, University of Massachusetts Amherst’s Isenberg School of Management
- **Australia:** University of New South Wales (UNSW), University of Melbourne
- **United Kingdom:** UK Sailing Academy
- **South Korea:** Kyung Hee University, Sookmyung Women’s University, Dankook University
- **Ireland:** National College of Ireland, University College Cork, University College Dublin
- **Hong Kong:** Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (HKUST)
- **Vietnam:** VinUniversity, British University Vietnam
- **Canada:** McMaster University

These are examples, not a complete list. ISPH also reports that its 2026 graduating class received offers from 26 universities across six countries; offers don’t necessarily mean students enrolled. Sources: [ISPH alumni page](https://isph.edu.vn/about-us/our-alumni/) and [Year 13 graduation announcement](https://isph.edu.vn/year-13-graduation-ceremony/).
